exceptions.reason: User-requested single capsule geometry must also reach retained legacy action links; existing business markup and handlers stay intact.
exceptions.scope: Only border-radius aliases for existing ls-button and app-topbar-action controls. No colour, event, layout or business changes are waived.
exceptions.reviewAt: Remove legacy aliases when the corresponding action-link consumers use lq-btn; desktop shell and nested control checks cover this adapter.

exceptions.reason: The S3 adapter has been extracted unchanged for the S4 shell. Existing header_actions nodes keep their original business hooks and form/iframe identity; this CSS only pairs their current app-topbar-action foreground and background with LQ tokens.
exceptions.scope: Only existing app-topbar-action descendants of lq-manage-context-actions, including responsive, reduced-motion and forced-colors rules. No new legacy markup, page content or business controller is covered.
exceptions.reviewAt: S4 regular-page header action consumer migration; remove as each remaining authored slot moves to LQ controls

exceptions.reason: Shared navigation must retain the authored navbar_actions block and its live form/iframe nodes. The local adapter colors those existing controls without cloning them or registering another business event owner.
exceptions.scope: Only existing app-topbar-action descendants of lq-navbar-context-actions and their forced-colors pairing. Native new navigation uses LQ controls.
exceptions.reviewAt: S4 dashboard/growth/profile page consumer migration; remove after all navbar_actions callers use LQ controls

policy: Exceptions need exact path, rule names, reason, owner, scope and reviewAt. Unmigrated files only warn; no blanket waiver counts as acceptance.
